This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

In 1992, Ken Barger was asleep when his phone rang. Reaching in the dark, he grabbed his nearby Smith & Wesson .38 Special revolver instead of the phone. When he placed it next to his ear, the firearm discharged, killing him instantly. What other everyday objects that turn dangerous should we cover next?
